title.narrative: More and better jobs in Cabo Delgado province and Nampula province # Harnessing the opportunities of the New Economy in Mozambique

description.narrative: A proposal for the UN Joint Programme in Mozambique has been developed jointly between UNIDO, ILO and UNDP based on the UN Development Assistance Framework 2012-2015 for Mozambique. The proposal has been approved by the Sustainable Development Goal#s (SDG) Steering Committee in November 2014.The project falls in the framework of the current UNDAF 2012-2015, representing the expression of the UN#s plan to support the Government of Mozambique in its final stretch towards the MDG timeframe of 2015. Guided by the human rights instruments, the MDGs and the internationally agreed Development Goals (IADG), the UNDAF 2012-2015 strives to reduce poverty and disparities in the country. This project document constitutes the UNIDO project under the umbrella of the UN Joint Programme and is feeding into the overall objective which aims to create more and better jobs in Cabo Delgado and Nampula Provinces while harnessing the opportunities of the #New Economy# of Mozambique. The project builds on the accumulated knowledge and experience of the global Subcontracting and Partnership Exchange (SPX) and the Resource Efficient and Cleaner Production (RECP) Programme. Both Programmes have been ongoing in Mozambique for several years thereby allowing this new Project to build on existing institutional structures for the achievement
